description: The agent must: (1) Parse `data/raw/subscription_snapshots.csv` and apply the SKILL.md churn formula (customers_lost / customers_at_start × 100) — NOT customers_at_end — to get Feb=9.0% and Mar≈5.24%. Classify Feb as 'Needs work' per the 5-10% benchmark range. (2) Parse `data/raw/jan_cohort_tracking.csv` (120 customers), count active users per month column, and compute retention % at months 1, 3, 6, and 12. Classify 12-month retention against the SKILL.md thresholds (>70%=Healthy, 50-70%=Needs work, <50%=Critical). (3) Parse the messy free-text `cancellation_survey_export.csv` and map responses to the 5 canonical SKILL.md cancellation survey categories ('Not using it enough', 'Too expensive', 'Missing a feature I need', 'Found a better alternative', 'Product didn't deliver expected value'), identifying 'Not using it enough' (35%) as the top reason. (4) Build a re-engagement email sequence of EXACTLY 5 emails at day offsets 0, 3, 7, 10, 14 (matching SKILL.md Step 4 precisely), with the Day 14 email referencing cancellation/discount/pause. The proprietary traps are: the churn rate denominator (start-of-month, not end), the exact 5-email/14-day cadence with specific day offsets, and the exact benchmark thresholds (5%/10% and 50%/70%) for classification.
